description: Given a list of characters x, return true if it is a palindrome, i.e. x[i] equals x[len(x) - 1 - i] for every index i, and false otherwise. The empty list is a palindrome.
notes: The palindrome condition is stated in Dafny with the recursive predicate MirroredFrom ({:fuel 10}), equivalent to forall i < |x|, x[i] == x[|x| - i - 1]; with the plain quantifier Dafny cannot decide the false cases on concrete inputs. The Python spec keeps VERINA's form.
